objective: Proof and computation. Across a 3-edge cut of a knot space, after removing any line not on the point side, the hub stays held (its three points tied) and the solutions are the join of the two sides along one binary value. Because the knot is symmetric under complementing every value, a circuit through the hub is deficient at both values. Hence the knots crossing the cut are exactly the eliminations (K1 u K2) - h of a circuit through the hub on each side (ties included): the 2-sum of the two sides, cycle-like composition at the hubs selection leaves. A control without complement symmetry fails. Checked on splices of Fano planes, K4^(3), the 6-point space and their duals.
status: Proved by HUB-GLUE-20261102-001B-P001: across a simple 3-edge cut of a knot space, after removing a line off the point side, the ports stay tied (one binary value h), the solutions are the join of the two sides along h, and complement symmetry gives the two halves of every projection equal size; hence the crossing circuits are exactly the 2-sums of a circuit through the hub on each side (ties included), none containing a port. Checked: 200 removals, 2300 crossing circuits equal to the predicted 2-sums; an OR control fails
title: Through a held hub, emergence composes as a 2-sum
